description: Does the P1 variability of CBG survive restriction to high-identity orthologs? Entropy and dominant-residue frequency at the structural P1, raw vs restricted to >=70% and >=85% global identity.
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
out=os.getcwd(); R=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(out,"ortholog_RCL_hinge_scores.csv"))
FAMS=["SERPINA6 (CBG)","SERPINA1 (A1AT)","SERPINA7 (TBG)"]
COL={"SERPINA6 (CBG)":"#c0392b","SERPINA1 (A1AT)":"#2471a3","SERPINA7 (TBG)":"#7d3c98"}

def shannon(s):
    p=s.value_counts(normalize=True).values
    return float(-(p*np.log2(p)).sum())

rows=[]
for thr in [0,70,85]:
    S=R[R.pct_id>=thr]
    for f in FAMS:
        d=S[S.family==f]
        for site in ["P1","P14","P17"]:
            v=d[site][d[site]!="-"]
            if len(v)<5: continue
            top=v.value_counts(normalize=True)
            rows.append(dict(threshold=thr,family=f,site=site,n=len(v),
                             top_residue=top.index[0],top_freq=round(top.iloc[0]*100,1),
                             entropy_bits=round(shannon(v),2)))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("Residue conservation at three reactive centre loop positions:\n")
for thr in [0,70,85]:
    print(f"--- orthologs with global identity >= {thr}% ---")
    print(T[T.threshold==thr].pivot_table(index="site",columns="family",
          values=["top_residue","top_freq","n"],aggfunc="first").to_string())
    print()

print("Fisher exact: species whose P1 matches the family's modal residue (>=70% identity set)")
S=R[R.pct_id>=70]
for f in ["SERPINA6 (CBG)","SERPINA7 (TBG)"]:
    a=S[S.family==f].P1; b=S[S.family=="SERPINA1 (A1AT)"].P1
    am=a.value_counts().iloc[0]; bm=b.value_counts().iloc[0]
    odds,p=fisher_exact([[am,len(a)-am],[bm,len(b)-bm]])
    print(f"  {f} ({am}/{len(a)}) vs A1AT ({bm}/{len(b)}): OR={odds:.3f}, p={p:.3g}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14,4.4),sharey=True)
for ax,thr in zip(axes,[0,70,85]):
    S=R[R.pct_id>=thr]
    for i,f in enumerate(FAMS):
        v=S[S.family==f].P1; v=v[v!="-"]
        if len(v)<5: continue
        ax.bar(i,v.value_counts(normalize=True).iloc[0]*100,width=0.6,color=COL[f])
        ax.text(i,v.value_counts(normalize=True).iloc[0]*100+2,
                f"{v.value_counts().index[0]}\nn={len(v)}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels([f.split(" ")[0] for f in FAMS],fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title(f"orthologs >= {thr}% global identity",fontsize=10); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=0.3)
    ax.set_ylim(0,112)
axes[0].set_ylabel("% of species sharing the modal P1 residue")
fig.suptitle("The reactive bond residue is fixed in SERPINA1 and SERPINA7 but free to vary in SERPINA6",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
